items.note: Resolved on exact lab bytes introduced by commit 60a04f0c92fd4805c4de606683fbe93f77bc5789 and unchanged at reviewed head 3dfe19769ea53c4abe414baea07a597fd30dab79. probeWidths still reads every finite supported pixel minimum and source order is still checked independently, but filters each generated ceil(width) and following-integer render candidate at Chromium's inclusive 10,000,000px cap. Independent pinned-Chromium probes accepted 10,000,000 and rejected 10,000,001; harmless ordered rules at 10,000,000, 10,000,001, 9,999,999.5 and 10,000,000.1px all passed 7/7 without an unrepresentable request, while an above-cap out-of-order counterexample was still rejected. The complete retained matrix accepted all 11 valid routes and rejected all 21 invalid routes. In particular, ordered valid 800px two-column and 1200px grid controls passed 7/7, while ordered 800px three-column and 1200px block overrides each failed only its applicable rendered task at 6/1. No new SME finding was found.
